consistency.underlyingState: Keep the underlying state and overlay DOM alive; a separate modal owns presentation only.
consistency.combat: Pause game update, spawn director, projectiles, telegraphs, healing, resources, cooldowns, timers and combat rendering during the ceremony.
consistency.storage: Growth commits before presentation. Saves retain the original run state; refresh restores earned growth and pending content without replaying the ceremony.
consistency.failure: No presentation or cost remains after a failed growth save. A foreign-writer conflict cancels the ceremony without overwriting its conflict screen.
consistency.automatic: A full recipe may ascend during living combat and pending reward screens; title, pause, death and save-conflict remain excluded.
consistency.minorLayers: Minor layer effects remain short and never take over the full screen.
consistency.manual: Existing manual missing-material risk rules remain in the published build.

validation.bounds: Mobile verification uses 390px portrait and 844px landscape viewports on desktop Edge; no physical-device frame-rate claim.
